form.label: Commvault CommCell - SOC Overview
form.description: Detections, anomalies, authentication, privileged audit activity, and backup health for index=commvault (SC4S commvault:commcell:* sourcetypes). Backup infrastructure is a primary ransomware target: watch the anomaly, failed-login, and destructive-operation panels first.

panel.title: Total events

search.query: index=commvault | stats count

panel.title: Anomaly alerts

search.query: index=commvault Alertcriteria="Anomaly*" | stats count

panel.title: Critical severity

search.query: index=commvault (Alertseverity="Critical" OR Eventseverity="Critical" OR Severitylevel="Critical") | stats count

panel.title: Failed logins

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" (Operation="Login Failed" OR Details="*Login failed*") | stats count

panel.title: Failed-job alerts

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:alert" (Alertname="*fail*" OR Alertcriteria="*fail*") | stats count

panel.title: Distinct users logged in

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" Operation="User Logged in" | stats dc(Username)

panel.title: Event volume by family

search.query: index=commvault | timechart count by sourcetype

panel.title: Severity distribution (all families, Major folded into Critical, Minor into Low)

search.query: index=commvault | eval Severity=coalesce(Alertseverity, Eventseverity, Severitylevel, "Unknown") | eval Severity=case(Severity=="Major", "Critical", Severity=="Minor", "Low", true(), Severity) | stats count by Severity

panel.title: Volume by CommCell and forwarding host

search.query: index=commvault | stats count by Commcellname host sourcetype | sort -count

panel.title: DETECTION: Commvault anomaly indicators (unusual activity; can include ransomware)

search.query: index=commvault Alertcriteria="Anomaly*" | timechart count by Alertcriteria

panel.title: Anomaly alert detail (file activity, event-rate, and failed-job anomalies)

search.query: index=commvault Alertcriteria="Anomaly*" | sort -_time | table _time Commcellname Alertcriteria Alertname Companyname Jobid Alertseverity Alertdescription | head 50

panel.title: Login activity by user

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" Operation="User Logged in" Username="$user_tok$" | timechart count by Username limit=20 useother=true

panel.title: Login sources: who is logging in from where

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" Operation="User Logged in" Username="$user_tok$" | stats count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen by Username cv_login_src cv_login_from | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%F %T"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | sort -count | rename cv_login_src as "Source host/IP" cv_login_from as "Console"

panel.title: DETECTION: Failed logins (5+ failures flagged red)

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" (Operation="Login Failed" OR Details="*Login failed*") Username="$user_tok$" | stats count latest(_time) as last_attempt values(cv_login_machine) as machines latest(cv_login_reason) as latest_reason by Username | eval last_attempt=strftime(last_attempt, "%F %T") | sort -count

panel.title: DETECTION: New login source per user (first seen in last 24h, 30d baseline)

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" Operation="User Logged in" | stats earliest(_time) as first_seen count by Username cv_login_src cv_login_from | where first_seen >= relative_time(now(), "-24h") | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%F %T") | sort -count | rename cv_login_src as "Source host/IP" cv_login_from as "Console"

panel.title: DETECTION: After-hours audit activity (21:00-06:00, excludes logouts)

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" Username="$user_tok$" Operation!="User Logged out" | eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time, "%H")) | where hour < 6 OR hour >= 21 | stats count values(Operation) as operations latest(_time) as last_seen by Username | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | sort -count

panel.title: DETECTION: Privileged / destructive audit operations (delete, retention, security, policy, kill, credential changes)

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" Username="$user_tok$" Operation!="User Logged in" Operation!="User Logged out" (Operation="*delete*" OR Operation="*user*" OR Operation="*security*" OR Operation="*password*" OR Operation="*retention*" OR Operation="*aging*" OR Operation="*kill*" OR Operation="*erase*" OR Operation="*activity*" OR Operation="*policy*" OR Operation="*plan*" OR Operation="*credential*" OR Operation="*workflow*" OR Operation="*schedule*") | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen latest(Details) as latest_detail by Username Operation | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | sort -count

panel.title: Audit operations over time

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" | timechart count by Operation limit=10 useother=true

panel.title: Elevated-severity audit events

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:audittrail" Severitylevel!="Low" | sort -_time | table _time Severitylevel Username Operation Details | head 50

panel.title: Top event codes (enriched from commvault_eventcodes lookup)

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:event" Eventcode=* | stats count latest(Description) as latest_example by Eventcode | lookup commvault_eventcodes event_code as Eventcode OUTPUTNEW event_string | eval event_string=coalesce(event_string, eventcode_description, "(not in lookup - regenerate commvault_eventcodes.csv)") | sort -count | head 20 | table Eventcode event_string count latest_example

panel.title: Events severity trend

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:event" | timechart count by Eventseverity

panel.title: Job duration distribution (per Jobid, first event to last event)

search.query: index=commvault Jobid=* | rename Jobid as jobid | makemv jobid | stats earliest(_time) as StartTime latest(_time) as EndTime by jobid | eval TimeTakenMin=ceiling((EndTime - StartTime) / 60) | eval TimeTakenHr=ceiling(TimeTakenMin / 60) | eval CompletedIn=case(TimeTakenHr<=1, "0-1 hr", TimeTakenHr<=2, "1-2 hrs", TimeTakenHr<=4, "2-4 hrs", TimeTakenHr<=8, "4-8 hrs", true(), "8+ hrs") | stats count as jobs by CompletedIn | eval sort_key=case(CompletedIn="0-1 hr", 1, CompletedIn="1-2 hrs", 2, CompletedIn="2-4 hrs", 3, CompletedIn="4-8 hrs", 4, true(), 5) | sort sort_key | fields - sort_key

panel.title: Failed-job alerts by company

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell:alert" (Alertname="*fail*" OR Alertcriteria="*fail*") | fillnull value="unknown" Companyname | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen latest(Alertdescription) as latest_description by Companyname Alertname | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | sort -count | head 20

panel.title: Tape media import/export activity (media barcode by IE port, base sourcetype)

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell" | rex field=message "^(?<media_barcode>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\s*-\s*(?<ie_port>IEPort\d+)\s*$" | where isnotnull(media_barcode) | stats count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen by media_barcode ie_port | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%F %T"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | sort -last_seen

panel.title: Tape movements per IE port

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell" | rex field=message "^(?<media_barcode>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\s*-\s*(?<ie_port>IEPort\d+)\s*$" | where isnotnull(ie_port) | timechart count by ie_port

panel.title: Unclassified base-sourcetype events (no family match, not tape movement)

search.query: index=commvault sourcetype="commvault:commcell" | rex field=message "^(?<media_barcode>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\s*-\s*(?<ie_port>IEPort\d+)\s*$" | where isnull(media_barcode) | sort -_time | table _time host message | head 20
